target: Shopify Files — serum selector tiles, re-measured
decided_by: Malcolm, 2026-08-25 — the matrixyl bottle looked bigger and the copper peptide smaller than the rest
note:
Re-frames the five SERUM tiles against boxes read off a labelled grid instead of found automatically. The cream tiles are unchanged and are not re-uploaded.

WHAT WENT WRONG. Edge-energy detection cannot tell a bottle from its mirror image, nor find a white pipette bulb against a white sweep:
  copper    the box ran down into the bottle's REFLECTION, overstating height 1215 -> 1669, so re-framing shrank the real bottle to 56% of frame while its neighbours sat near 75%.
  matrixyl  the box CUT OFF the white bulb, understating height 1825 -> 1539, so re-framing blew it up to 91%.
The reference itself was 4% out as well - PDRN measures 71.0% true against 76.9% detected, shadow included - which is why acetyl and glutathione came out consistent with each other but not with the stated target.

Measured, all five now land on 71.0%: the PDRN bottle, which is the reference Malcolm chose.

THE LESSON IS THE CHECK, NOT THE ALGORITHM. Each box was verified against a drawn overlay before the first publish and two were already rejected that way - but the two that survived were wrong in the one direction an overlay at thumbnail size does not reveal. A number checked only against itself gets believed; these needed the rendered page, at size, side by side.

NEW FILENAMES: Shopify Files suffixes on collision rather than replacing, so re-using the -selector names would have kept serving the old framing.
